name: D.C. Eagles
description: D.C. Eagles is an outlaw motorcycle club founded in Chicago, Illinois in 1963 by Danny LeDesma, known as 'DC Danny'. The name derives from the intersection of Damen Avenue and Cortland Street in Chicago's Bucktown/Wicker Park neighborhood where the club originated. It appears in Illinois law enforcement surveys of outlaw motorcycle clubs alongside the Outlaws and Hells Angels, and was also noted as a rival of Chicago greaser clubs including the Aristocrats.
